title: The Duck on the Dock
lines: A duck sits on the dock.
Nick has a sack of buns.
The duck pecks at the sack.
The duck pecks at his sock!
Nick sits back on the dock.
A bun falls off. The duck gets it.
Nick picks up the sack of buns.
Nick and the duck sit on the dock.

questions.ask: What does the duck do to Nick's sock?
questions.listenFor: It pecks at it. This is stated in the story - if they guess, have them find the line with sock in it.

questions.ask: Why does a bun fall off the dock?
questions.listenFor: Nick sat back when the duck pecked at his sock. You are listening for the chain of events, not just "it fell."

questions.ask: Do you think the duck planned this? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is correct. What you want is a reason from the story, like "yes, it pecked the sack first."
